code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low pH, low oxygen saturation, low pO₂), with mild anemia, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia, and abnormal white cell differential (lymphopenia, monocytosis, basophilia). There is markedly elevated ferritin, D-dimer, LDH, INR, and alkaline phosphatase, suggesting significant inflammation, possible coagulopathy, and tissue injury. Findings are consistent with severe systemic illness, possibly sepsis or severe respiratory failure. Immediate clinical attention is warranted.
